title.narrative: Scaling-up decarbonization initiatives for State of Chihuahua (Phase 2)

description.narrative: The project aims to implement green growth policies in line with the State of Chihuahua's Development Plan (2022-2027). It focuses on establishing a State-level financial mechanism and implementing sectoral interventions for industrial park decarbonization.

This projectwill support the development of a State-level financial mechanism plus sectoral interventions fostering decarbonization of industrial parks in the State. Namely, the components are described as follows:1) GREEN FINANCE AND INVESTMENTS: STATE-LEVEL FINANCIAL INSTRUMENT. This component will escalate the intervention logic of Phase I (circumscribed to FIDEAPECH), with a view to developing an analysis of the state situation and building the case for the greening state finances based on the development of a sustainable framework.2) GREEN INDUSTRIAL PARKS BY DESIGN: PROJECT STRUCTURING. This component will continue phase I through the start-up of pilots or early implementations of industrial decarbonization (specifically, the structuring of a project to install solar panels in the Chihuahua Industrial Complex). Likewise, a road map and an intervention pilot are provided to green the buildings of the state public administration.Worth noting:this project is a natural continuation of project MX32 (paid for with earmarked resources of the State of Chihuahua under a consulting contract figure). As such, it provides clear vote ofconfidence inour subnational work, and it will be the secondtime that the State counterpart willprovide resources to carry out work.This idea is linked to Decision Memo 3832, which has been already reviewed and cleared by Mexico CR, Head of Partnerships, Siva and Cristobal and is awaiting approval subject to counterpart's logistics.
